policy: Six r!=20 arrays are mathematical exclusions. SafeAPI refuses without changing arrays; native code is not asserted to refuse them.

source_controls.name: omit-prefix-reversal
source_controls.semantic_change: Do not normalize a descending prefix

source_controls.name: copy-left-not-tail
source_controls.semantic_change: Copy sourceA0 instead of A20 into scratch0

source_controls.name: merge-signed-compare
source_controls.semantic_change: Use signed64 compare for both choice and cursor

source_controls.name: choose-min-at-back
source_controls.semantic_change: Choose smaller output while retaining native cursor condition

source_controls.name: truncate-tail32
source_controls.semantic_change: Lose upper32 bits of copied tail

source_controls.name: omit-left-empty-terminal-copy
source_controls.semantic_change: Skip final8-byte logical copy after left exhaustion

source_controls.name: tie-loaded-bits-tail
source_controls.semantic_change: Use tail bits provider on equality; equal words remain equal

source_controls.name: retire-left-on-tie
source_controls.semantic_change: Consume equal left words before tail; raw sorted multiset unchanged, cursor/store observations change

source_controls.name: omit-zero-copy-observation
source_controls.semantic_change: Omit terminal0-byte logical call observation only

status: frozen before any Rust source for this r20 route
unsafe_native_control: remaining-copy-wrong-destination is not a source/value control; see CONTROL-ERRATUM.json
